name: Castmagic
summary: AI platform that turns one recording into transcripts, show notes, clips, social posts and newsletters.
description: Content repurposing platform for podcasters and content teams: import or upload a recording (1,800+ platforms, plus files, RSS and Zapier) and get a speaker-labelled transcript with timestamps, then AI-drafted show notes, chapters, clips, social posts, newsletters and blog articles in a trained brand voice. Teams draft, review and publish together in shared workspaces with reusable templates and custom prompts.
contains: import from 1,800+ platforms plus upload, RSS and Zapier
brand voice training with reusable templates and custom prompts
team workspaces with user permissions, folders and review workflows
